Script Plugin Request Stencil Solid Drill or aka Blender Knife-Project

LightWave, MODO, and Blender have a very useful mesh detailing feature known as either Stencil, Solid Drill or also known as Knife-Project where you could import SVG or Adobe Illustrator or EPS as a "cutter" to detail the model

to learn more about what it is and does please have a look at the videos

Lightwave/MODO stencil and solid drill

knife-project in Blender

this would proof to be extremely useful for the Cheetah3D community as very complex geometry is possible with the click of a button

Links: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t9yT98fQXt0, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vIMYKvYAfKA
